simple.meaning: properly, to dawn , i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking)

simple.summary: שָׁחַר (shâchar) means properly, to dawn , i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking) First listed occurrence: Hos 5 15.

definitions.short: properly, to dawn , i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking)
definitions.usage: (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).
definitions.full: H7836. shachar [ שָׁחר ] verb denominative look early, diligently for (late; originally look for dawn ); — Qal Participle טוֺב שֹׁחֵר Prov 11:27 (|| דָּרַשׁ בִּקֵּשׁ, ), elsewhere Pi`el with accusative (suffix) Perfect 3masculine singular suffix מוּסָר שִׁחֲרוֺ Prov 13:24 seeks him early (with) discipline (chastises him be-times); 2 masculine singular suffix consecutive וְאֵינֶנִּי וְשִׁחַרְתַּ֫נִי Job 7:21 ; literally Infinitive מָּנֶיךָ לְשַׁחֵר Prov 7:15 ; of wild asses, Participle לַטָּ֑רֶף מְשַׁחֲרֵי Job 24:5 (Ges § 130a ) seeking eagerly for their food ; usually of seeking God ( ׳י ) earnestly, Perfect וְשִׁחֲרוּאֵֿל Psa 78:34 (|| דָּרַשׁ ), Imperfect 2masculine singular אֶלאֵֿל תְּשַׁחֵר Job 8:5 (si vera lectio), 3masculine singular suffix יְשַׁחֲרֻנְנִי (Ges § 60e ) Hosea 5:15 (|| בִּקֵּשׁ ), + 6:3 (see שַׁחַר ), and, accusative wisdom, Prov 1:28 , Participle suffix מְשַׁחֲרַי 8:17 ; seek with longing, long for ( ׳י ), אֲשַׁחֲרֶ֑ךָּ Isa 26:9 ; Psa 63:2 . שַׁחֲרוּת see I. שָׁחַר . above
